title: Optimistic Games for Combinatorial Bayesian Optimization with Application to Protein Design
relevance: Directly proposes game-theoretic approach (GameOpt) for combinatorial protein design. Establishes cooperative games between optimization variables with UCB acquisition. Core inspiration for this concept card.
key_finding: GameOpt iteratively selects informative protein configurations as game equilibria and quickly discovers highly active variants compared to standard BO baselines.

title: Toward real-world automated antibody design with combinatorial Bayesian optimization
relevance: AntBO framework uses combinatorial BO with trust regions for antibody CDRH3 design. Demonstrates that game-like decomposition of combinatorial spaces achieves high-affinity designs in under 200 oracle calls.
key_finding: AntBO suggests antibodies outperforming the best from 6.9 million experimentally obtained CDRH3s in under 200 calls.

title: Machine learning-guided multi-site combinatorial mutagenesis enhances the thermostability of pectin lyase
relevance: ML-guided combinatorial mutagenesis achieving 67-fold half-life increase. Demonstrates practical value of efficient combinatorial search over single-mutant starting points.
key_finding: ML-predicted library enriched with thermostable combinatorial mutants; best mutant P36 showed 67-fold increase in half-life at 75C.
